MAJ40164.title: Digital Systems Security
MAJ40164.description:
Information and systems security is becoming increasingly important for everyday life: we want technology to protect our digital information such as IDs, assets and data security, and to secure email and online privacy for individuals, homes, families and offices.

Employees with skills in information and systems security are in strong demand across all sectors: from banking to finance, insurance, retail, government and defence, all fields where there is sensitive data and information that is at risk of being hacked and breached via the internet

MAJ40516.title: Cyber Security
MAJ40516.description:
Cyber security is about how we develop secure computers and computer networks, to ensure that the data stored and transmitted through them is protected from unauthorised access or to combat digital security threats and hazards. As we conduct more of our social, consumer and business activities online, there is a corresponding increase in the demand for ICT professionals to manage our digital environment and economy.

Cyber security has been identified as one of the strategic priorities in Australia to meet the demands of law enforcement, national and state governments, defence, security and finance industries. Jobs of the future will be in all of these areas ensuring there is national capability to maintain and build our essential services and stop them from being disrupted, destroyed, or threatened, and that our personal information is not communicated, shared, visualised or analysed without our permission.

In the Cyber Security major you will study technical and political concepts of current topics of cyber security, such as blockchain, cryptocurrency, multimedia security, Internet of Things (IoT) security, obfuscation and reverse engineering. You will learn penetration testing skills for defensive purposes and be prepared for ethical hacking certification.

MAJ44306.title: Digital Systems Security and Cyber Security
MAJ44306.description:
The Cyber Security & Digital Systems Security double major equips students with the essential knowledge and skills to safeguard our increasingly interconnected world against unauthorised access, digital threats, and security breaches. As society becomes more reliant on digital technologies for social, consumer, and business activities, there is a growing need for professionals who can protect critical data and systems while ensuring online privacy and security.

This double major combines the technical and theoretical foundations of cyber security with the practical applications of digital systems security. Students will explore advanced topics, such as blockchain, cryptocurrency, multimedia security, Internet of Things (IoT) security, reverse engineering, and obfuscation. Hands-on learning in penetration testing and preparation for ethical hacking certification ensures graduates are ready to address real-world security challenges.

In parallel, the program focuses on digital systems security, where students will learn to secure personal and organisational data, digital identities, and assets across a wide range of applications. With growing vulnerabilities in sectors such as banking, finance, insurance, retail, government, and defence, students will gain the expertise to design, implement, and manage robust systems that protect sensitive information and maintain digital trust.

Graduates of this program will be uniquely positioned to address strategic priorities in cyber and digital systems security. Whether preventing disruptions to essential services, safeguarding national infrastructure, or protecting personal data from misuse, they will play a pivotal role in securing the digital future across industries. With strong demand for expertise in this field, this double major offers an exciting pathway to impactful and future-ready careers.

MAJ44307.title: Artificial Intelligence and Big Data and Cyber Security
MAJ44307.description:
The Artificial Intelligence and Big Data and Cyber Security fields represent critical and complementary domains in today’s digital landscape, addressing challenges across science, society, and business. Artificial Intelligence (AI) focuses on simulating intelligence using computers, often relying on the analysis of massive datasets, commonly referred to as Big Data. Together, these fields enable innovative solutions to complex problems, from population growth and medical technology to transport, trade, and security. Meanwhile, Cyber Security ensures the integrity, confidentiality, and availability of the systems and data that AI and Big Data rely upon, protecting them from unauthorised access and digital threats.

As modern AI depends on large-scale data, professionals with expertise in data mining, visualisation, analysis, and discovery are essential for extracting meaningful insights from complex datasets. These skills are vital for driving strategic decisions and innovation in sectors like healthcare, commerce, and public policy. Equally, the growth of online social, consumer, and business activities has increased the need for Cyber Security professionals who can secure our digital environment and economy. From safeguarding personal information to defending essential services, Cyber Security plays a pivotal role in ensuring a safe and reliable digital future.

Cyber Security is a global priority, with high demand across law enforcement, government, defence, and finance sectors. Similarly, the combined expertise in AI and Big Data is integral to solving global issues and advancing industries through intelligent systems. This comprehensive program covers cutting-edge topics such as blockchain, cryptocurrency, multimedia security, Internet of Things (IoT) security, obfuscation, and reverse engineering. Students also gain practical skills in penetration testing, ethical hacking certification, and data manipulation, equipping them for careers at the forefront of innovation and defence.

Graduates will be uniquely prepared to meet the challenges of an interconnected digital world, where securing data and systems is as crucial as analysing and utilising them to drive progress. With opportunities spanning diverse industries, this program offers a future-focused pathway to impactful and rewarding careers.

MAJ44308.title: Digital Systems Security and Artificial Intelligence and Big Data
MAJ44308.description:
The Artificial Intelligence and Big Data and Digital Systems Security fields are at the forefront of addressing critical challenges in science, society, and business. Artificial Intelligence (AI) focuses on simulating intelligence using computers, while Big Data is concerned with processing datasets that are too large and complex for traditional methods. These complementary fields work together, as modern AI relies on vast quantities of data to achieve its objectives. Combined, they provide innovative solutions to pressing global issues such as population growth, transport, security, medical technology, trade, and commerce.

As digital transformation accelerates, information and systems security have become essential to everyday life. Protecting digital identities, assets, and sensitive data is crucial not only for individuals but also for businesses, governments, and industries. Whether securing personal email and online privacy or safeguarding critical infrastructure in sectors such as banking, finance, insurance, retail, and defence, the demand for skilled professionals in these areas continues to grow.

Students in this program will develop expertise in leveraging AI and Big Data to uncover strategic insights through data mining, visualisation, analysis, manipulation, and discovery. They will also gain the knowledge needed to secure digital information and systems, ensuring data integrity and privacy in an era of increasing cyber threats. These combined skills position graduates to play vital roles in advancing industries, protecting sensitive information, and shaping a secure and intelligent digital future.

With strong demand across sectors for expertise in AI, Big Data, and Digital Systems Security, this program offers a future-ready pathway to innovative and impactful careers.
